audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagreed with the packet chart in four rows (0, 3, 5, 6) and the full/content layers had to move together.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Irelia, and the mirror audit (irelia__heimerdinger) already set exactly those four rows. A 56.3% win rate over 254 games also contradicts a stated 8.5/10 difficulty.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 5 and 6 flipped to Skill, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Irelia in both phases[N].side and win[N] as one atomic group, ratings 5/10, 8/10, 8/10, 3/10, and diffRating lowered to 6/10 with the difficulty prose to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose leaned on Defiant Dance as the reason her all-in survives, and the first-item spike never said what Liandry's plus anti-heal actually beats.
audit.why: CH-3X Lightning Grenade is a flat 11s at every rank at 970 range against Flawless Duet's 16s at rank 1, so the cooldown gap is the spike. Bladesurge heals her, so Grievous Wounds timing is the first-item spike.
audit.corrected: Level-6 spike, phases[3].why, phases[5].why and mid now carry the flat 11s / 970 grenade and the anti-heal-versus-Bladesurge line; the 2+ item row credits Trinity Force resets and passive shred to Irelia.

audit.whatIsWrong: Multiple lines told the player Irelia holds Defiant Dance (W) to eat Heimerdinger's burst and the CH-3X stun.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.' Heimerdinger's turret beams, Hextech Micro-Rockets and CH-3X are magic damage, and damage reduction is not CC immunity. Her real answer is sidestepping the grenade, which is a single skillshot on a flat cooldown.
audit.corrected: whys[4], spikes[2].text, mid and wants.foe[1] rewritten to state Defiant Dance cuts physical only and that dodging the grenade is her out; pronouns corrected from 'he/his' to 'she/her' in the trading lines.

audit.whatIsWrong: Flawless Duet was tracked but never numbered.
audit.why: Flawless Duet is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s; CH-3X is a flat 11s. Early levels the grenade comes back first, which is the whole trading pattern.
audit.corrected: Cooldown numbers written into phases[3].why and mid.

audit.why: Anti-heal was already called for in report[8]; the missing-interaction rule (needs-antiheal off Bladesurge) is now also stated in the first-item spike row and mid.

edits.before: This is my stretch. With three banked turret charges and the CH-3X center-stun online, her Q-in all-in is suicide: I drop the grenade on her dash landing, the center-stun freezes her in the beams, and the W-rocket spread plus turret fire chunk her before her Defiant Dance damage-reduction window expires. Bait the W — if she pops Defiant Dance to cut the burst, hold and let the active drop, then commit the stun. At 6, UPGRADE the CH-3X for a wider, longer root, or drop a super-turret so her Q engage feeds itself to the nest.
edits.after: This is my stretch. With three banked turret charges and CH-3X online — a flat 11s at every rank, 970 range, against her 16s Flawless Duet — her Q-in all-in is suicide: stun her on the dash landing and the beams plus the Hextech Micro-Rockets spread chunk her while she is frozen. Defiant Dance only reduces physical damage, so it does nothing to my magic; dodging the grenade is her one real out, and Oblivion Orb answers the Bladesurge healing in longer trades. At 6, UPGRADE the CH-3X for a wider, longer stun, or drop a super-turret so her Q engage feeds itself to the nest.

edits.after: Keep Irelia farming inside turret range, rocket her step-ups, and CH-3X her the moment she commits into the nest.
